scope: The built-in templates (ADR-0016) at 540×960, 30 fps on in-house fixtures: barcode videos (pixel truth), ffmpeg test videos and pictures (mandelbrot, testsrc2, smptebars) and a synthetic 120 BPM drum loop analysed by the product. Rule-based; no model. Not judged by a person: nobody has watched these edits for taste.

checks.name: the gallery lists the built-in templates (rule-based; no model) and then the model-gated ones as unavailable with their reason
planning a model-gated template is refused with 409 needs_capability and nothing is downloaded

detail.message: template tpl.text-behind-subject needs a video subject-segmentation model (a matte of the person in every frame), which is not installed on this machine; templates never download models
detail.hint: Choose one of the available templates (GET /api/v1/templates).

checks.name: every built-in template is available on this machine (graphic elements need an ffmpeg with librsvg)
